- Would be able to work from home a couple of days a week.
- Emphasis on building relationships of trust with Ops personnel and helping them understand EHS is here to help and partner, not hinder.

- Last interview would be with Jesse again, just a lot shorter since this one ran so long.
- Mentioned that should I need to be able to work remote while I find housing in NOVA, he could see what HR could do in that regard.

Had really good small talk around him doing the Odin Project and learning to code in bits and pieces. I shared my interest in being a life long learner around getting a PMP, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Building a 2nd Brain and Obsidian.

Said he hopes he speaks with me again very soon.....
